player_action: At 1278-08-09 15:11, Shiki answers Ibiki's direct question «Кто-нибудь из вас заметил что-либо необычное в поведении второй команды Травы до её исчезновения?» with exactly «Нет». This answer is knowingly inconsistent with Shiki's earlier personally observed five exchanged glances and a finger signal involving Kabuto and second Grass team, but GM must not impose an unspoken motive. Shiki does not divulge anything about Kabuto. No subsequent Shiki words/actions declared.

events.event: Ibiki notes Shiki's plain negative answer and does not pretend he can read thoughts or prove dishonesty. Ren says he did not interact with second Grass team and noticed nothing, Aki says she did not pay attention or memorize faces. Tose says team did aid hospital. Ibiki says Kusa team not accused of invasion, irregular second-team records still under investigation; returns to Leaf investigative work. Ibiki publicly confirms Shiki medical-wing defense is in report. Nothing of Kabuto privately shared by Shiki is exposed.

Ren is frustrated at inquiry; Aki differentiates observation and responsibility; Tose tells them official Kusa identity could have been used by impostors, decides to notify Kusa separately, does not interrogate students again.

events.scene: Temporary foreign delegation residence inside Konoha
events.event: Leaf gradually relaxes foreign-delegation movement restrictions; Kusa delegation administratively moved from hospital to protected lodging, with wheelchair and medical escort for Aki; the team has stayed together as their established standing pattern. Aki still nonambulatory with immobilized broken leg. Konoha Chunin exam commission to prepare closed evaluation of candidates even though Hokage dead; final promotions require future approval, not yet issued. Report requests Shiki combat record, two wins, volunteer forfeit vs Gaara, medical-wing defense. Tose receives notice of secure scheduled evening call with Kusa command regarding second Grass team discrepancy. No conclusion yet and no Kusa response received.
Tose with Shiki, Ren and Aki; Aki unable to walk unaided; exam report unresolved; Tose's evening call pending. Player retains agency, this is decision point.
